name: FlowEngine
description:
An engine to solve flow problem in saturated granular media. Model description can be found in [Chareyre2012a]_ and [Catalano2014a]_. See the example script FluidCouplingPFV/oedometer.py. More documentation to come.

.. note::Multi-threading seems to work fine for Cholesky decomposition, but it...

attributes.name: isActivated
attributes.description: Activates Flow Engine

attributes.name: first
attributes.description: Controls the initialization/update phases

attributes.name: idOffset
attributes.description: If the bounding walls of the fluid mesh are not walls of the scene (i.e. are not elements of O.bodies), the offset should be set equal to the size of O.bodies. If the bounding walls are bodies of the scene but are not numbered as 0-5 then offset should be the number of bodies comming before the walls. Set offset<0 to get it set equal to O.bodies.size(), it will also update

attributes.name: convertClumps
attributes.description: If true the clumps will be temptatively converted into equivalent spheres in the triangulation, and clump members are skipped. Else clumps are ignored and spherical clump members are triangulated as independent bodies.

attributes.name: doInterpolate
attributes.description: Force the interpolation of cell's info while remeshing. By default, interpolation would be done only for compressible fluids. It can be forced with this flag.

attributes.name: fluidBulkModulus
attributes.description: Bulk modulus of fluid (inverse of compressibility) K=-dP*V/dV [Pa]. Flow is compressible if fluidBulkModulus > 0, else incompressible.

attributes.name: fluidRho
attributes.description: Density of fluid (for thermalEngine).

attributes.name: fluidCp
attributes.description: Heat capacity of fluid (for thermalEngine).

attributes.name: dt
attributes.description: timestep [s]

attributes.name: permeabilityMap
attributes.description: Enable/disable stocking of average permeability scalar in cell infos.

attributes.name: slipBoundary
attributes.description: Controls friction condition on lateral walls

attributes.name: waveAction
attributes.description: Allow sinusoidal pressure condition to simulate ocean waves

attributes.name: sineMagnitude
attributes.description: Pressure value (amplitude) when sinusoidal pressure is applied (p )

attributes.name: sineAverage
attributes.description: Pressure value (average) when sinusoidal pressure is applied

attributes.name: debug
attributes.description: Activate debug messages

attributes.name: wallThickness
attributes.description: Walls thickness

attributes.name: pZero
attributes.description: The value used for initializing pore pressure. It is useless for incompressible fluid, but important for compressible model.

attributes.name: tZero
attributes.description: The value used for initializing pore temperatures in thermalEngine.

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: Gauss-Seidel tolerance

attributes.name: relax
attributes.description: Gauss-Seidel relaxation

attributes.name: updateTriangulation
attributes.description: If true the medium is retriangulated. Can be switched on to force retriangulation after some events (else it will be true periodicaly based on defTolerance and meshUpdateInterval. Of course, it costs CPU time. Note that the new triangulation will start to be effectively used only after one iteration (i.e. O.run(2) gives a result with the new one, O.run(1) does not).

attributes.name: meshUpdateInterval
attributes.description: Maximum number of timesteps between re-triangulation events (a negative value will never re-triangulate). See also

attributes.name: breakControlledRemesh
attributes.description: If true, remesh will occur everytime a break occurs in JCFpmPhys. Designed to increase accuracy and efficiency in hydraulic fracture simulations.

attributes.name: epsVolMax
attributes.description: Maximal absolute volumetric strain computed at each iteration. |yupdate|

attributes.name: defTolerance
attributes.description: Cumulated deformation threshold for which retriangulation of pore space is performed. If negative, the triangulation update will occure with a fixed frequency on the basis of

attributes.name: porosity
attributes.description: Porosity computed at each retriangulation |yupdate|

attributes.name: meanKStat
attributes.description: report the local permeabilities' correction

attributes.name: clampKValues
attributes.description: If true, clamp local permeabilities in [minKdivKmean,maxKdivKmean]*globalK. This clamping can avoid singular values in the permeability matrix and may reduce numerical errors in the solve phase. It will also hide junk values if they exist, or bias all values in very heterogeneous problems. So, use this with care.

attributes.name: minKdivKmean
attributes.description: define the min K value (see

attributes.name: maxKdivKmean
attributes.description: define the max K value (see

attributes.name: permeabilityFactor
attributes.description: Permability multiplier ($m$): $m=1$ (default) attempts to predicty the actual hydraulic conductivity using a Poiseuille equation; $m>0$ multiplies the default values by $m$; $m<0$ defines the conductivity independently of particle size and viscosity as if the material was a homogeneous continuum of conductivity $-m$

attributes.name: cavityFactor
attributes.description: Permeability/viscosity for cavity cell neighbors (arbitrarily high to model triangulated fluid filled cavity).

attributes.name: volumeFactor
attributes.description: Factor used for simulating low porosity (for thermal considerations only) in high porosity DEM packings.

attributes.name: flatThreshold
attributes.description: If >=0, pore volumes below flatThreshold value are blocked from flow calc. Useful for compressible flow involving odd triangulations with some very flat pores.

attributes.name: viscosity
attributes.description: viscosity of the fluid

attributes.name: tempDependentViscosity
attributes.description: boolean to vary viscosity (ultimately cell permeability) with cell temperature. Linear model for viscosity b/w 20-70 degC. If true, kFactor must also be set negative, and becomes the darcy permeability.

attributes.name: desiredPorosity
attributes.description: Correct the cell volumes to reflect this desired porosity (not active by default (0)).

attributes.name: volumeCorrection
attributes.description: Volume correction factor (not user controlled. auto computed if

attributes.name: stiffness
attributes.description: equivalent contact stiffness used in the lubrication model

attributes.name: useSolver
attributes.description: Solver to use. 0:Gauss-Seidel, 3: Cholesky factorization (via Eigen3 interface), 4:multicore CPU or GPU accelerated CHOLMOD (without Eigen3), 1-2: undefined.

attributes.name: xmin
attributes.description: Index of the boundary $x_{min}$. This index is not equal the the id of the corresponding body in general, it may be used to access the corresponding attributes (e.g. flow.bndCondValue[flow.xmin], flow.wallId[flow.xmin],...).

attributes.name: xmax
attributes.description: See xmin.

attributes.name: ymin
attributes.description: See xmin.

attributes.name: ymax
attributes.description: See xmin.

attributes.name: zmin
attributes.description: See xmin.

attributes.name: zmax
attributes.description: See xmin.

attributes.name: bndCondIsPressure
attributes.description: defines the type of boundary condition for each side. True if pressure is imposed, False for no-flux. Indexes can be retrieved with

attributes.name: bndCondIsTemperature
attributes.description: defines the type of boundary condition for each side of triangulation (used with ThermalEngine only). True if temperature is imposed, False for no heat-flux. Indexes can be retrieved with xmin and friends.

attributes.name: bndCondValue
attributes.description: Imposed value of a boundary condition. Only applies if the boundary condition is imposed pressure, else the imposed flux is always zero presently (may be generalized to non-zero imposed fluxes in the future).

attributes.name: thermalBndCondValue
attributes.description: Imposed temperature boundary condition value for the cells in the triangulation (used with

attributes.name: boundaryVelocity
attributes.description: velocity on top boundary, only change it using

attributes.name: ignoredBody
attributes.description: DEPRECATED, USE MASK - Id of a sphere to exclude from the triangulation.)

attributes.name: mask
attributes.description: If mask defined, only bodies with corresponding groupMask will be affected by this engine. If 0, all bodies will be affected.

attributes.name: wallIds
attributes.description: body ids of the boundaries (default values are ok only if aabbWalls are appended before spheres, i.e. numbered 0,...,5)

attributes.name: boundaryUseMaxMin
attributes.description: If true (default value) bounding sphere is added as function of max/min sphere coord, if false as function of yade wall position

attributes.name: viscousShear
attributes.description: compute viscous shear terms as developped by Donia Marzougui (FIXME: ref.)

attributes.name: shearLubrication
attributes.description: compute shear lubrication force as developped by Brule (FIXME: ref.)

attributes.name: pumpTorque
attributes.description: Compute pump torque applied on particles

attributes.name: twistTorque
attributes.description: Compute twist torque applied on particles

attributes.name: eps
attributes.description: roughness defined as a fraction of particles size, giving the minimum distance between particles in the lubrication model.

attributes.name: pressureForce
attributes.description: compute the pressure field and associated fluid forces. WARNING: turning off means fluid flow is not computed at all.

attributes.name: normalLubrication
attributes.description: compute normal lubrication force as developped by Brule

attributes.name: viscousNormalBodyStress
attributes.description: compute normal viscous stress applied on each body

attributes.name: viscousShearBodyStress
attributes.description: compute shear viscous stress applied on each body

attributes.name: multithread
attributes.description: Build triangulation and factorize in the background (multi-thread mode)

attributes.name: decoupleForces
attributes.description: If true, viscous and pressure forces are not imposed on particles. Useful for speeding up simulations in ultra-stiff cohesive materials.

attributes.name: getCHOLMODPerfTimings
attributes.description: Print CHOLMOD build, analyze, and factorize timings

attributes.name: numSolveThreads
attributes.description: number of openblas threads in the solve phase.

attributes.name: numFactorizeThreads
attributes.description: number of openblas threads in the factorization phase

attributes.name: boundaryPressure
attributes.description: values defining pressure along x-axis for the top surface. See also

attributes.name: boundaryXPos
attributes.description: values of the x-coordinate for which pressure is defined. See also

attributes.name: blockHook
attributes.description: Python command to be run when remeshing. Anticipated usage: define blocked cells (see also FlowEngine.blockCell), or apply exotic types of boundary conditions which need to visit the newly built mesh

attributes.name: fixTriUpdatePermInt
attributes.description: If positive, triangulation is fixed and DFNFlow trickPermeability is run according to the interval. Activating this automatically sets

attributes.name: thermalEngine
attributes.description: activate thermalEngine within FlowEngine.

attributes.name: iniVoidVolumes
attributes.description: activate the computation of the inverse of the initial void volumes in each cell when pore volumes are initialized.

attributes.name: controlCavityPressure
attributes.description: use full cavity flux and fluidbulkmodulus to control cavity as dynamic pressure (dirichlet) boundary condition.

attributes.name: controlCavityVolumeChange
attributes.description: cavity imposes a volume change on neighbor cells (shouldnt be used with controlCavityPressure)

attributes.name: phiZero
attributes.description: if >0, considers water aircontent impact on fluid compressibility.

attributes.name: cavityFlux
attributes.description: For adding flux to pressuremanaged cavity model (controlCavityPressure). Negavite influx, postive outflux.

attributes.name: cavityFluidDensity
attributes.description: >0 means cavity compressibility model considers density changes instead of volume changes.

attributes.name: thermalPorosity
attributes.description: >0 means the void volume space will be factored by thermalPorosity for pore internal energy considerations.

attributes.name: averageCavityPressure
attributes.description: true means the pressure in the cavity will be averaged each iteration.

attributes.name: alphaBound
attributes.description: if 0, use an alphaBoundary condition where CGAL finds minimum alpha necessary for a single solid object. Any positive value will be used for the alpha. All negative values deactivate the functionality.

attributes.name: alphaBoundValue
attributes.description: value of alpha constant pressure condition

attributes.name: fixedAlpha
attributes.description: If true, a constant-sized alpha vertex will be placed exactly above each facet. If false, logic is used to improve cell sizes in concave regions.

attributes.name: minimumPorosity
attributes.description: value used to limit the allowable minimum porosity for pore volume calculations. Particularly useful if very small volumes are impacting stability

attributes.name: meanK_opt
attributes.description: |ydeprecated| alias for clampKValues (the name changed)

attributes.name: forceMetis
attributes.description: If true, METIS is used for matrix preconditioning, else Cholmod is free to choose the best method (which may be METIS to, depending on the matrix). See ``nmethods`` in Cholmod documentation

attributes.name: ids
attributes.description: Ids list of bodies affected by this PartialEngine.

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == ``True``).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == ``True``).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == ``True``.

methods.name: OSI
methods.description: Return the number of interactions only between spheres.

methods.name: avFlVelOnSph
methods.description: compute a sphere-centered average fluid velocity

methods.name: averagePressure
methods.description: Measure averaged pore pressure in the entire volume, the cells adjacent to the boundaries are ignored if includeBoundaries=False

methods.name: averageSlicePressure
methods.description: Measure slice-averaged pore pressure at height posY

methods.name: averageVelocity
methods.description: measure the mean velocity in the period

methods.name: blockCell
methods.description: block cell 'id'. The cell will be excluded from the fluid flow problem and the conductivity of all incident facets will be null. If blockPressure=False, deformation is reflected in the pressure, else it is constantly 0.

methods.name: bodyNormalLubStress
methods.description: Return the normal lubrication stress on sphere idSph.

methods.name: bodyShearLubStress
methods.description: Return the shear lubrication stress on sphere idSph.

methods.name: cholmodStats
methods.description: get statistics of cholmod solver activity

methods.name: clearImposedFlux
methods.description: Clear the list of points with flux imposed.

methods.name: clearImposedPressure
methods.description: Clear the list of points with pressure imposed.

methods.name: compTessVolumes
methods.description: Like TesselationWrapper::computeVolumes()

methods.name: edgeSize
methods.description: Return the number of interactions.

methods.name: emulateAction
methods.description: get scene and run action (may be used to manipulate an engine outside the timestepping loop).

methods.name: exportMatrix
methods.description: Export system matrix to a file with all entries (even zeros will displayed).

methods.name: exportTriplets
methods.description: Export system matrix to a file with only non-zero entries.

methods.name: fluidForce
methods.description: Return the fluid force on sphere idSph.

methods.name: getBoundaryFluidArea
methods.description: Get total fluid area associated with boundary defined by its body id.

methods.name: getBoundaryFlux
methods.description: Get total flux through boundary defined by its body id.

methods.name: getBoundaryVel
methods.description: Get total avg cell velocity associated with boundary defined by its body id.

methods.name: getBoundaryVolume
methods.description: Get total volume flowing through boundary defined by its body id in current timestep dt.

methods.name: getCavityDensity
methods.description: Return the density of cavity fluid.

methods.name: getCavityFlux
methods.description: Return the flux through the edge of the cavity.

methods.name: getCell
methods.description: get id of the cell containing (X,Y,Z).

methods.name: getCellBarycenter
methods.description: get barycenter of cell 'id'.

methods.name: getCellCenter
methods.description: get voronoi center of cell 'id'.

methods.name: getCellFlux
methods.description: Get influx in cell associated to an imposed P (indexed using 'cond').

methods.name: getCellFluxFromId
methods.description: Get influx in cell.

methods.name: getCellInvVoidVolume
methods.description: get the inverse of the cell volume for cell 'id' after pore volumes have been initialized and FlowEngine:iniVoidVolumes = True, or compressibility scheme active with FlowEngine::fluidBulkModulus.

methods.name: getCellPImposed
methods.description: get the status of cell 'id' wrt imposed pressure.

methods.name: getCellPressure
methods.description: get pressure by cell 'id'. Note: getting pressure at position (x,y,z) might be more usefull, see :yref`FlowEngine::getPorePressure`:

methods.name: getCellTImposed
methods.description: get the status of cell 'id' wrt imposed temperature.

methods.name: getCellTemperature
methods.description: get pressure in cell 'id'.

methods.name: getCellVelocity
methods.description: Get relative cell velocity at position pos[0] pos [1] pos[2].

methods.name: getCellVolume
methods.description: Get volume of cell at position pos[0] pos [1] pos[2].

methods.name: getConductivity
methods.description: get conductivity from cell and throat, with throat between 0 and 3 (same ordering as incident cells)

methods.name: getConstrictions
methods.description: Get the list of constriction radii (inscribed circle) for all finite facets (if all==True) or all facets not incident to a virtual bounding sphere (if all==False).  When all facets are returned, negative radii denote facet incident to one or more fictious spheres.

methods.name: getConstrictionsFull
methods.description: Get the list of constrictions (inscribed circle) for all finite facets (if all==True), or all facets not incident to a fictious bounding sphere (if all==False). When all facets are returned, negative radii denote facet incident to one or more fictious spheres. The constrictions are returned in the format {{cell1,cell2}{rad,nx,ny,nz}}

methods.name: getDiffusionCoeff
methods.description: get the ratio of throat cross-sectional area and distance between two cells

methods.name: getEquivalentCompressibility
methods.description: Return the equivalent compressibility used for modeling air water mixture in cavity.

methods.name: getIncidentCells
methods.description: get ids of all cells of which vertexId is a vertex. Typical usage is for getting cells indident to a boundary.

methods.name: getNeighbors
methods.description: get 4 neigboring cells

methods.name: getPorePressure
methods.description: Measure pore pressure in position pos[0],pos[1],pos[2]

methods.name: getPoreTemperature
methods.description: Measure pore pressure in position pos[0],pos[1],pos[2]

methods.name: getVertices
methods.description: get the vertices of a cell

methods.name: imposeCavity
methods.description: Cell with location 'pos' participates in a cavity (high conductivity and no volume factoring). The index of the condition is returned (for multiple imposed pressures at different points).

methods.name: imposeFlux
methods.description: Impose a flux in cell located  at 'pos' (i.e. add a source term in the flow problem). Outflux positive, influx negative.

methods.name: imposePressure
methods.description: Impose pressure in cell of location 'pos'. The index of the condition is returned (for multiple imposed pressures at different points).

methods.name: imposePressureFromId
methods.description: Impose pressure in cell of index 'id' (after remeshing the same condition will apply for the same location, regardless of what the new cell index is at this location). The index of the condition itself is returned (for multiple imposed pressures at different points).

methods.name: initializeVolumes
methods.description: initialize pore volumes.

methods.name: isCellNeighbor
methods.description: check if cell1 and cell2 are neigbors.

methods.name: metisUsed
methods.description: check wether metis lib is effectively used

methods.name: nCells
methods.description: get the total number of finite cells in the triangulation.

methods.name: normalLubForce
methods.description: Return the normal lubrication force on sphere idSph.

methods.name: normalVect
methods.description: Return the normal vector between particles.

methods.name: normalVelocity
methods.description: Return the normal velocity of the interaction.

methods.name: onlySpheresInteractions
methods.description: Return the id of the interaction only between spheres.

methods.name: pressureProfile
methods.description: Measure pore pressure in 6 equally-spaced points along the height of the sample

methods.name: printVertices
methods.description: Export vertex positions and types

methods.name: resetLinearSystem
methods.description: trigger rebuild of the linear system while keeping the same triangulation

methods.name: saveVtk
methods.description: Save pressure field in vtk format. Specify a folder name for output. The cells adjacent to the bounding spheres are generated conditionally based on FlowEngine::withBoundaries (not compatible with periodic boundaries)

methods.name: setBoundaryNormal
methods.description: define the unit outward-pointing normal of a boundary (0<=index<=5).

methods.name: setCellPImposed
methods.description: make cell 'id' assignable with imposed pressure.

methods.name: setCellPressure
methods.description: set pressure in cell 'id'.

methods.name: setCellTImposed
methods.description: make cell 'id' assignable with imposed temperature.

methods.name: setCellTemperature
methods.description: set temperature in cell 'id'.

methods.name: setImposedPressure
methods.description: Set pressure value at the point indexed 'cond'.

methods.name: shearLubForce
methods.description: Return the shear lubrication force on sphere idSph.

methods.name: shearLubTorque
methods.description: Return the shear lubrication torque on sphere idSph.

methods.name: shearVelocity
methods.description: Return the shear velocity of the interaction.

methods.name: surfaceDistanceParticle
methods.description: Return the distance between particles.

methods.name: surfaceSolidThroatInPore
methods.description: returns solid area in the throat (index 0-3), keeping only that part of the throat in cell.

methods.name: updateBCs
methods.description: Update the boundary condition to reflect changes of boundary pressure (needed typically after changing FlowEngine::bndCondValue). It is not sufficient to reflect changes of the type of boundary condition (FlowEngine::bndCondIsPressure), in such case re-triangulation or at least updating the linear system is needed (see FlowEngine::updateTriangulation and FlowEngine::updateLinearSystem). Conversely, the update is not necessary for changing the value of point-wise imposed pressure (FlowEngine::imposePressure)

methods.name: updateVolumes
methods.description: update rates of volume change

methods.name: volume
methods.description: Returns the volume of Voronoi's cell of a sphere.
